name: Half Adder Circuit
objectives: Understand binary addition of two 1-bit numbers (A and B).
Construct Sum and Carry logic using basic gates (XOR 7486 + AND 7408).
Optimize the design using Universal NAND gates (IC 7400).
theory: A Half Adder adds two single binary digits A and B. It produces two outputs: Sum (S = A ⊕ B) and Carry (C = A · B).

foundation.title: Foundation (Basic Gates)
foundation.description: Construct the Half Adder using 1 XOR gate (IC 7486) for Sum and 1 AND gate (IC 7408) for Carry.

optimization.title: Universal NAND Gate Synthesis
optimization.description: Rebuild the Half Adder using ONLY Universal NAND gates (IC 7400).

industrial.title: Universal NOR Gate Synthesis
industrial.description: Rebuild the Half Adder using ONLY Universal NOR gates (IC 7402).
